title: Describe the requested design
responsibility: Builds a product-design prompt with Harness styling and the selected thread’s visual context.

inputs.name: designPrompt.context
inputs.description: A RunContext used to read `entity.title`, find the `entity.threads` entry whose `id` equals `request.threadId`, and read its state, viewport, and region; the other context fields are not read by this helper. If no matching thread exists, state and viewport are `default` and `desktop`; a missing or falsy region becomes `whole image`, while a truthy region is serialized with `JSON.stringify`.

inputs.name: designPrompt.prompt
inputs.description: The caller's feedback text, appended verbatim after the helper's fixed instructions and context lines. It is not parsed or length-checked by this helper.
examples: Keep the primary action visible at narrow widths.

outputs.name: designPrompt
outputs.description: A text-only prompt with fixed Harness visual and control instructions, the entity title, selected thread state and viewport, a reference-image revision instruction focused on the serialized thread region or `whole image`, and the supplied feedback. Missing thread state and viewport fall back to `default` and `desktop`, region fallback applies when falsy, and this function does not generate or inspect an image.
examples:
Generate a realistic product design, matching the existing dark navy/gold Harness form factor. Top icon navbar: Pages, Shells, Components, Helpers, Configs, Services, Models. Branch/commit controls at the right. No Reports, no global Plan/App toggle. Model, CLI provider and Plan/Change controls belong inside the comment composer. Verification is only a check or X with tooltip. Source files only in Details → Source.
Entity: Button. State: default. Viewport: desktop.
If a reference image is attached, revise it according to this feedback. Focus on normalized rectangle whole image; preserve the other design decisions.
Add a compact loading state.
